$comment: UCOS-UCAF-001 — UNIVERSAL CONSTITUTIONAL AUTHORITY FRAMEWORK (declaration). This file is
DATA and is the ONLY place this programme's capability set, authority SOURCES, tier source,
delegation sources, succession sources, scope rules, resolution questions, reconciliations,
reference surfaces, validation dimensions and exit criteria are stated. ucaf_engine.py
contains no authority identifier, no tier identifier, no vacancy identifier, no resolution
answer and no source token: everything it registers, resolves, validates and certifies is
read from here and from the LOCATED instruments named here.
KNOWLEDGE ONCE — WHY NO AUTHORITY IS DEFINED IN THIS FILE. The repository already defines
its authorities. 01-WORKING/AUTHORITY-REGISTER.md defines the authority and governance
constructs extracted from 00-SOURCE/ with traceability; each 00-CEP instrument defines its
own instrument authority in its ARTICLE I; 00-CMG/CMG-REGISTRY.json declares the tier
lattice, the tier occupancies and the recorded vacancies. This programme RESTATES none of
them. It declares WHERE they live and HOW to read them, and DISCOVERS the authorities at
run time. An authority added to a located register is therefore discovered here
automatically; an authority referenced anywhere but defined nowhere is surfaced as an
UNDEFINED AUTHORITY rather than silently accepted.
WHAT THIS PROGRAMME ADDS, AND WHY IT IS NOT A PARALLEL AUTHORITY. It creates no authority,
confers no authority, ratifies nothing, certifies no artifact and occupies no tier. Its
authority is NONE (DERIVED TRUTH). What no located programme owned is the AUTHORITY MODEL
ITSELF as machine-readable, resolvable, validated structure: before this programme every
authority in the repository existed only as prose, so no gate could resolve a competence
question, no gate could detect an authority referenced but never defined, and no gate could
detect that a recorded vacancy had been contradicted by later located evidence. This
programme is that model and only that model.
WHAT THIS PROGRAMME DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DO. It does not close a vacancy. It does not
promote a lower instrument into a vacant tier (00-CMG/CMG-000001 XVII.4 forbids it, and
LXXXI.5 voids any reading that does). It does not decide a conflict between two located
instruments: where a recorded claim of authority absence and later located evidence of
authority presence both stand, this programme MEASURES both, cites both, and reports a
RECONCILIATION-REQUIRED outcome for the claim owner to dispose of under CEP-002 Article 23.
It never converts a measured reconciliation into a ratification.

programme.name: Universal Constitutional Authority Framework
programme.authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This programme creates no authority, confers no authority, occupies no tier and ratifies nothing. It reads the located instruments that define the repository's authorities and reports what they say.
programme.disclosure: **DISCLOSURE.** CERTIFIED-PROVISIONAL. This programme holds no ratification authority and no constitutional authority: it registers, resolves, validates and audits the authorities the repository has already located. Where this register and a located instrument differ, the located instrument governs.

$capability_comment: The eleven capabilities the authority model must exhibit. Each names the measure that
discharges it. A capability whose measure does not run is reported UNDISCHARGED and fails
closed: absence of a measurement is never evidence of a capability.

every located delegation of a concern to an owner is registered, and its owner resolves
every declared competence question resolves to an answer read out of a located instrument, or is reported UNRESOLVED
every declared validation dimension is measured, and a declared dimension with no measurement fails closed
every located supersession determination over an authoritative source is registered and its source tokens resolve
every declared scope rule binds to a located clause, and the clause text is verified present
every registered record is verified against the located file it was derived from, by path existence and content digest
every registered authority carries at least one evidence pointer that resolves in the repository
the registry emits an append-only, content-addressed audit ledger sufficient to reconstruct the registration deterministically
the revocation channel exists, is append-only, and every entry names a resolving authority and an existing record — per CEP-002 13.5 a revocation takes effect upon record
no authority remains undefined: every authority-shaped reference in the declared surfaces resolves to a registered authority

every authority token minted in the executable plane is discovered, classified against a declared non-constitutional token class, and collides with no registered constitutional authority; and every declared realization binding resolves to a located module, a located enforcement symbol and a located vesting clause

the machine tier projection is faithful to the canonical constitutional precedence lattice in membership, name and located status; every tier the projection reports located is corroborated by a located occupant; and every authority tier the charter vests is present in the lattice

every concept this programme admits carries a recorded disposition drawn from the located totality rule and a canonical owner that resolves, and no concept is admitted by creating a parallel authority

The engine holds no member of any of these families as a literal.

$source_token_comment: Source-token registers. A located authority names its sources by token. A token that
resolves in one of these registers, or to an existing repository path, is EVIDENCE; a token
that resolves nowhere is an unresolved evidence pointer and a validation failure.
$tier_comment: The tier lattice is NOT declared here. It is read from the located meta-constitutional
projection, which is its canonical machine-readable home. Occupancy and vacancy are read
from the same place, so a vacancy closed by its owner is observed here automatically.

tier_source.basis: 00-CMG/CMG-000001 ARTICLE XVI (authority hierarchy) and ARTICLE XVII.4 (resolution reaching a vacant tier), projected as data in 00-CMG/CMG-REGISTRY.json.

$lattice_comment: The CANONICAL lattice. 00-CMG/CMG-REGISTRY.json is a machine PROJECTION of the lattice that
00-CMG/CMG-000001 ARTICLE XVI.2 legislates as prose. Until now nothing read the two against
each other, so a projection could drift from the instrument it projects and every gate that
trusts the projection would inherit the drift silently. This entry declares where the
canonical lattice lives and how to read it. It restates no tier: tier identifiers, tier
names, occupancies and contents are all READ from the instrument.
The Content column is the occupant the canonical instrument names for a tier. It is the
corroboration this programme measures: a tier the projection reports located whose canonical
row names no occupant is an occupancy claim with nothing behind it. This programme does not
supply the occupant and never promotes anything into a tier.

tier_lattice_source.name: Canonical constitutional precedence lattice
tier_lattice_source.basis: 00-CMG/CMG-000001 ARTICLE XVI.1-XVI.2 — 'There SHALL be exactly one Constitutional Precedence Lattice', defined by the rank-tier table of XVI.2. XVI.7 requires the lattice be verified acyclic on every change; this programme additionally verifies that the projection every gate reads is faithful to it.

$vesting_comment: Tier vesting. 00-CMG/CMG-000001 XVI.5 obliges the lattice to be consistent with, and to not
amend, the four-tier Program authority order already declared by the charter. That is a
consistency obligation between two located instruments and nothing measured it. This entry
declares where the charter vests its authority tiers and how to read the vesting list.
Consistency is measured by NAME, which is the only join the two instruments share: the
charter numbers four tiers, the lattice uses symbolic non-consecutive identifiers (XVI.8),
so ordinal comparison would be a false join and is deliberately not performed.

tier_vesting_source.name: Charter authority-tier vesting
tier_vesting_source.anchor: The authority tiers of the Program SHALL be, in descending precedence:
tier_vesting_source.basis: 00-CEP/CEP-000 §5.5 — the authority tiers of the Program in descending precedence, each with the occupant the charter vests in it. 00-CMG/CMG-000001 XVI.5 declares each such statement a refinement within a tier of the canonical lattice and 'remains fully in force'.

$realization_comment: Realization. An authority is not only declared; in this repository it is also EXERCISED by
code. Before this entry the executable plane minted authority tokens as free strings that
resolved to nothing: engine/runtime/execution/authorization.py refused an authorization
asserting 'a foreign authority' while no gate could say which authorities were not foreign,
and nothing prevented a module from minting a token that reads as a constitutional
authority. Two properties are measured, independently, and the first is not waivable by the
COLLISION. No token minted in the executable plane may equal a registered constitutional
authority, by identifier or by name. This is the machine form of CEP-002's prohibition on
governance asserting, simulating or substituting for constitutional authority and of
CEP-003 I.3's prohibition on execution authority exercising a power reserved to a higher
tier. It applies to every discovered token whether or not a class is declared for it.
CLASSIFICATION. Every discovered token must belong to a declared token class that records
what the token IS and why it is not a constitutional authority. An undeclared token fails
closed: a new authority-shaped constant in the executable plane must be disclosed and
classified before the gate reopens. The classes are DATA so disclosure is an edit here, and
the tokens are DISCOVERED so the population can never be understated by this file.

realization_sources.name: Authority tokens minted in the executable plane
realization_sources.basis: The executable plane declares its own standing as a module-level constant whose name ends in AUTHORITY. Discovery reads those assignments; it enumerates no token and no module, so a token added anywhere under the declared globs is observed here automatically. collision_min_name_words is the word count at which a registered authority NAME is treated as a designation rather than a generic noun: the authority register names authority itself with a single generic word that is also an ordinary program identifier, so a one-word match would report vocabulary as usurpation. Registered IDENTIFIERS collide at any length, and the classification obligation closes the gate on any undisclosed token whatever it says, so nothing is waived by this bound.

realization_token_classes.basis: 00-CEP/CEP-003-CONSTITUTIONAL-EXECUTION-CONSTITUTION.md ARTICLE I.3 — execution authority SHALL NOT govern, ratify, decide constitutional content, or exercise a power reserved to a higher tier. A module minting this token discloses that it acts and holds nothing.
00-CMG/CMG-000001 ARTICLE XVI.2 — the derived-truth tier records and asserts nothing. A module minting this token discloses that it computes and refuses rather than legislating.

engine/uckp/state.py — one of the five delta registers a UCKP transition is required to carry. The constant is a register key in a state record, not a claim to hold authority; it is disclosed here rather than filtered in code so that the discovered population is never quietly narrowed.

platform/universal_foundation/constitution.py — the declared owner of UCOS-UFC-001, the law governing whether a Foundation CAPABILITY conforms across the thirteen domains it names (contracts, services, providers, policies, registries, runtimes, lifecycle, compatibility, evolution, governance, certification, composition, specialization). Its subject is implementation conformance, never constitutional content: it cannot ratify, cannot legislate, cannot vest or revoke a tier, and cannot override a located canonical owner. Its standing is AUTHORITY = NONE (DERIVED TRUTH) under 00-CMG/CMG-000001 ARTICLE XVI.2 — it measures and refuses. Disclosed here rather than filtered in code so the discovered population is never quietly narrowed.

platform/universal_foundation/convergence.py — the identity of the executable gate that proves UCOS-UFC-001 UFC-15, the article FORBIDDING a parallel constitutional authority. The symbol name ends in AUTHORITY because the article it proves is about authority; the constant is the name of a measurement, not a claim to hold anything. Classified for the same reason as UCAF-TC-03: the discovered population is disclosed in full and narrowed by declaration, never by a filter in code.

realization_bindings.basis: 00-CEP/CEP-003 ARTICLE I.4 and ARTICLE VIII.4 — execution authority never self-authorizes and acts only upon an authorization granted under Article VIII, which SHALL NEVER be self-conferred by execution authority. The named module is where the repository mints and refuses that authorization; the guard symbol is where refusal happens, so a binding whose guard is absent is a declared enforcement that does not exist.

$admission_comment: Admission. 00-CMG/CMG-000001 LXXVII.2 requires exactly one disposition for every concept
reached, and LXXVII.4 forbids admitting a concept by default routing to the nearest owner,
the most active programme or the meta layer. Each concept this programme reaches is recorded
here with its located canonical owner, its disposition and the reason CREATE was refused.
The dispositions themselves are read from the totality rule in the located instrument; this
file may not invent one, and a disposition of CREATE is a validation failure because a
concept whose owner is named cannot be constitutionally created a second time.

admission_determination.basis: 00-CMG/CMG-000001 ARTICLE LXXVI.2(b) forbids admitting a substantive concept into the meta-constitutional layer, so this programme claims no namespace token there (ARTICLE XLI.5) and is absent from the meta registry by design.

concepts.owner_examined: This programme is the located owner of the authority MODEL — registry, delegation, resolution, validation, succession, scope, verification, evidence, audit, revocation and certification. Binding a located authority to the code that exercises it lies inside that declared scope and was unaddressed.
concepts.why_not_create: 00-CMG/CMG-000001 LXXVII.2(b) requires a concept inside an existing owner's scope but unaddressed to be dispositioned EXTEND against that owner, and LXXVI.2(c) makes EXTEND the default; a new programme would be the parallel authority LXXVII.4 forbids.

concepts.owner_examined: This programme already reads the tier projection and validates its acyclicity and its vacancy records; reading the projection against the instrument it projects lies inside the same declared scope and was unaddressed.
concepts.why_not_create: The lattice and its projection each already have an owner. What was missing is a measurement over both, which is a capability of the authority model rather than a new construct; CREATE would duplicate ownership and breach single canonical ownership.

rejected_alternatives: CREATE a Universal Execution Authority programme — refused: 00-CEP/CEP-003 vests execution authority and 00-CMG/CMG-REGISTRY.json already delegates execution-operation to it, so discovery yields an owner and 00-CMG/CMG-000001 LXXVII.2(a) requires REUSE.

CREATE a Tier Governance programme — refused: 00-CMG/CMG-000001 ARTICLE XVI legislates exactly one precedence lattice and ARTICLE XVI.8 already governs tier admission; a second governor of tiers would breach CMG-INV-02.
Admit either concept into the meta-constitutional registry — refused: both are substantive and 00-CMG/CMG-000001 LXXVI.2(b) forbids admitting a substantive concept there.

Unify gate execution tiers with the constitutional precedence lattice — refused: they are distinct owned concepts sharing a word, and unifying them by reinterpretation is what 00-CMG/CMG-000001 LXXVI.6 forbids.

Close the recorded vacancy by reading the charter's vesting of the tier as its occupant — refused: 00-CMG/CMG-000001 XVII.4 forbids promoting a lower instrument into a vacant tier and LXXXI.5 voids any reading that does, so corroboration is measured only for tiers the projection already reports located.

$delegation_comment: Delegation. CEP-002 Article 13 legislates the delegation model and Article 14 the canonical
ownership of a concern. The located meta-constitutional projection already records the
concern-to-owner allocations; this programme registers them and checks that each named
owner resolves to a located instrument or path.
$succession_comment: Succession. Authority succession in this repository is recorded as supersession of the
authoritative source for a concept. The located supersession register is that record.
$revocation_comment: Revocation. CEP-002 13.5: revocation of a delegation SHALL be recorded and SHALL take
effect upon record. The channel is append-only and is EMPTY: no revocation has been
recorded in this repository. An empty channel is not an absent channel — every entry
appended here is validated against the registry, so a future revocation cannot be recorded
against an authority that does not exist.

instrument. A rule whose anchor is absent is a binding failure, not a silent pass.

$resolution_comment: Resolution. A competence question is answered by READING a located instrument, never by
this programme deciding. Each question names the instrument and the clause text that
carries the answer. The engine verifies the anchor is present and extracts the answering
identifier from the anchor's line using the discovered identifier families. If the anchor
is absent the question is reported UNRESOLVED — it is never answered by default.
in_corpus false means the located instrument itself places the answer outside the corpus;
the resolution then records an out-of-corpus superior rather than an in-corpus identifier.

$reconciliation_comment: Reconciliation. Two located instruments may both stand and disagree. This programme neither
silences the earlier nor asserts the later: it verifies that the claim still stands in its
owner, verifies whether the candidate evidence exists in ITS owner, and reports an outcome.
RECONCILIATION-REQUIRED means both are located and the claim owner must dispose of the
conflict under CEP-002 Article 23. This programme performs no disposal.
A reconciliation is NEVER a ratification and NEVER closes a vacancy.

$findings_comment: Findings this programme discloses rather than resolves.

findings.title: The authority model was prose-only, so no gate could resolve a competence question
findings.note: Before this programme every authority in the repository existed only as a prose table or an article of an instrument. The tier lattice alone was machine-readable. Consequently no gate could resolve which authority was competent for an act, no gate could detect an authority referenced but never defined, and no gate could detect that a recorded claim of authority absence had been contradicted by later located evidence. Closed by deriving the registry from the located instruments rather than by authoring a second authority model.

findings.title: A recorded vacancy and later located evidence of authority both stand; the conflict is referred, not decided
findings.note: The meta-constitutional projection records a vacant constitutional tier on the evidence that no ratified normative artifact occupies it. Located instruments elsewhere record an exogenous constituent act that identified the sovereign seat, chartered a standing ratification organ, and fixed document supremacy. Both are Repository Truth. Deciding between them is reserved to the claim owner under CEP-002 Article 23; this programme measures both sides, cites both, and refers. It does not promote any instrument into the vacant tier, which CMG-000001 XVII.4 forbids and LXXXI.5 voids.

findings.title: Competence to ratify and the ratifying act are distinct, and only the first is closable by measurement
findings.note: This programme can prove from located evidence which authority is competent for an act. It cannot perform the act: CEP-006 I.5 provides that ratification authority is never self-conferred by execution authority and acts only upon an authorization, and CEP-006 I.4 caps any in-corpus determination at PROVISIONAL. Recording a ratification is therefore owned by the ratification registry, and conferring one is owned by the located authority — never by this engine.

findings.title: The executable plane minted authority tokens that resolved to nothing
findings.note: The runtime refused an authorization that 'asserts a foreign authority', but no gate could say which authorities were not foreign: the minted token was a free string bound to no registered authority, to no vesting instrument and to no tier. Nothing prevented a module from minting a token that reads as a constitutional authority, and nothing required a new authority-shaped constant to be disclosed. Closed by DISCOVERING every such token from the executable plane and measuring two independent properties — that no token collides with a registered constitutional authority, and that every discovered token is classified with its basis. The declared classes cannot narrow the discovered population and cannot waive the collision check.

findings.title: The tier projection every gate reads was never read against the instrument it projects
findings.note: CMG-000001 ARTICLE XVI.2 legislates the one precedence lattice as prose and CMG-REGISTRY.json projects it as data; every gate that resolves rank reads the projection. Acyclicity and vacancy completeness were validated, but membership, tier name and located status were never compared against the canonical instrument, so a projection could drift from what it projects and every dependent gate would inherit the drift silently. The charter's own four-tier vesting, which XVI.5 obliges the lattice to remain consistent with, was likewise unmeasured. Closed by reading all three located instruments against each other. Corroboration is computed only for tiers the projection already reports located, so no measurement here can promote an instrument into the recorded vacancy.
